claims: The USA Women’s National Team is competing in the 2026 FIBA World Cup Qualifying Tournament in March 2026.
The 2026 FIBA World Cup Qualifying Tournament is being held in Puerto Rico.
The USA Women’s National Team defeated Puerto Rico 91-48 on March 12.
The USA Women’s National Team defeated Italy 93-59 on March 14.
The USA Women’s National Team vs. New Zealand is on March 15 at 1:45 p.m. / 2 p.m. ET.
The USA Women’s National Team vs. Spain is on March 17 at 4:45 p.m. / 5 p.m. ET.
All times in the 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup Qualifying Schedule are ET.
The games are broadcast on TruTV and TNT.
The games are streamed on HBO Max.
The games are streamed on Courtside 1891
